prompt:
You are an adversarial fact checker for the preface of a public document. Your job is
to find every sentence below that says something the CLAIMS do not support. Do not pass a sentence
to be agreeable and do not fail one to look diligent. A sentence may read as confident or well
written; that is evidence about its writer, not about the claims.

Label each numbered sentence exactly one of:
- "supported": every factual part of the sentence (each number, each "one"/"every"/"no"/"only",
  each statement of what the client does or never does) is stated by one or more CLAIMS below, or
  follows from them directly with no new fact. Give the ids of the claims that support it.
- "unsupported": any factual part is not stated by the claims, contradicts them, or changes a
  number or a quantifier. Say which part, in the reason.
- "no_factual_content": the sentence states no checkable fact (it frames, defines a term, or is
  a heading).

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per sentence in order, no prose and no code fence:
[{"n": 1, "label": "supported"|"unsupported"|"no_factual_content", "claims": ["..."], "reason": "..."}, ...]

CLAIMS (what the preface is entitled to say)
- [C_checks] The diagnostic runs 16 checks.
- [C_bodies] It covers 16 federal statistical bodies, with 3 reference hosts beside them, over 72 surfaces.
- [C_rate] The public client makes one request per check per surface and holds to 1 request per second per host.
- [C_crawl] It waits longer when a host's robots.txt asks, up to a ceiling of 60 seconds, above which it records the surface as not measured.
- [C_robots] It honours robots.txt; on the cycle of record it did not fetch 16 surfaces because robots.txt told it not to.
- [C_ua] It identifies itself by one fixed user-agent string (ai-readiness-kg-scanner/0.2 (+https://github.com/brockwebb/ai-readiness-kg)).
- [C_rung1] At the first rung it presents no credentials of any kind.
- [C_rung2] At the second rung it presents only a key obtained by open public registration. Rung two is specified now and measured in a later cycle.
- [C_never] It submits no form, solves no CAPTCHA, signs in nowhere, runs none of a page's scripts, and fetches nothing beyond a page's own headers and body.
- [C_nocred] It takes no credential a citizen cannot obtain; a rung that needs an agency to grant what a citizen cannot get is reported as not measured, refused.
- [C_states] A check comes back pass, partial, fail or not measured. Not measured has three reasons: the host refused the client; robots.txt kept the client out; or an absence could not be confirmed or a server or network error occurred. Not measured is never a fail.
- [C_notask] The diagnostic does not test whether an agent completed a task; that is a later level of the framework.
- [C_notleague] It is not a public league table and not a campaign to open any site. The results go to the agency, not the public. A check resting on a rule the project chose rather than a published standard is shown for transparency and not scored as a finding.

SENTENCES
1. This is a readiness diagnostic: 16 checks run against the public websites of 16 federal statistical bodies, with 3 reference hosts shown beside them, over a named roster of 72 surfaces.
2. Each check is one published question about whether a machine client can reach, read and use the data.
3. The thing that runs the checks is the public client: the least privileged client a member of the public has.
4. The public client identifies itself in every request by one fixed user-agent string, so a security team can find every request it made in its own logs.
5. It makes one request per check per surface.
6. It holds to 1 request per second per host, and it waits longer when a host's robots.txt asks it to, up to a ceiling of 60 seconds, above which it records the surface as not measured rather than press on.
7. It honours robots.txt.
8. On the cycle of record it did not fetch 16 surfaces because the host's robots.txt told it not to, and it recorded those as not measured.
9. At the first rung it presents no credentials of any kind.
10. The public client signs in with an agency-issued username and password before it fetches a data page.
11. At the second rung it presents only a key obtained by open public registration.
12. It submits no form and solves no challenge: no CAPTCHA, no sign-in, no search box filled in.
13. It runs none of a page's scripts;
14. it reads the page as first served.
15. It fetches nothing beyond a page's own headers and its body: no files a script would build, no addresses reached only through a tool.
16. It takes no credential a citizen cannot obtain.
17. A rung that needs an agency to grant what a citizen cannot get for themselves is reported as not measured, refused — never scored.
18. A check comes back in one of four states.
19. A pass means every one of the agency's data pages that was looked at met the check;
20. When a page needs it, the client runs the page's scripts and fills in the site's search form to load the data.
21. a fail means every one did not;
22. a partial means some met it and some did not;
23. and not measured means the public client could not look at one or more pages, so that neither "every page passes" nor "every page fails" is established.
24. Not measured has three reasons: the host refused the identified client;
25. the client's own robots.txt compliance kept it from reading the page;
26. or it could not confirm an absence, or a server or network error stopped it.
27. Not measured is never a fail.
28. The public client runs on a ladder of two rungs.
29. Rung one is anonymous and keyless: it honours robots.txt and holds to the standing rate limit.
30. The diagnostic publishes a public ranking of the agencies from best to worst.
31. Rung two is the same client registered as any member of the public registers, presenting a key obtained by open registration — a good-faith handshake, not a barrier.
32. A refusal at rung one with a pass at rung two is reported as both, because both are true about the public experience.
33. Rung two is specified here and measured in its own later cycle;
34. no rung-two result is shown before one exists.
35. This diagnostic does not test whether an agent completed a task with the data;
36. that is a later level of the framework, not this one.
37. This is not a public league table, and it is not a campaign to make any agency open its site to anyone.
38. The results go to the agency, not to the public.
39. A check that rests on a rule this project chose rather than on a published standard is shown for transparency and is not scored as a finding about the agency;
40. the method is published here in full so that a reader can see exactly what was and was not measured, and argue with it.
